item.title: 【農業】 Homestead food production improves women’s dietary diversity in Bangladesh
item.description:
更新日時: 2026-05-12
出典元: https://www.nature.com/natfood.rss
概要: Nature Food, Published online: 12 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s43016-026-01353-w Empirical evidence on the contribution of different pathways through which homestead food production programmes may improve women’s dietary diversity remains scarce. In Bangladesh, garden production and nutrition education were found to be critical.

item.title: 【農業】 Impact pathways of a homestead food production programme on women’s dietary diversity in Bangladesh
item.description:
更新日時: 2026-05-12
出典元: https://www.nature.com/natfood.rss
概要: Nature Food, Published online: 12 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s43016-026-01354-9 The contribution of homestead food production (HFP) to nutrition and dietary diversity is context-specific and involves multiple pathways. Using panel data on 2,612 women in 96 settlements in rural Bangladesh, this study identifies and measures the impact pathways of a 3-year HFP intervention.
